# doppler_tag (Resource)

Manage a Doppler tag.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "doppler_tag" "backend" {
  name  = "Backend"
  color = "blue"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the tag

### Optional

- `color` (String) The color of the tag. One of `gray` (default), `purple`, `blue`, `green`, `yellow`, `orange`, `red`, or `pink`
- `slug` (String) The slug of the tag. Generated from the name when omitted

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import doppler_tag.default <tag-slug>
```
